header.subtitle: Most CRMs add “AI” as a feature label. We built our product around an AI coaching layer — daily action plans, weekly playbooks, peer benchmarks, and AI deep-dives that move the numbers that matter. Two programs cover everyone from new agents to top producers.

pillars.title: AI-driven daily plans
pillars.body: Every morning the dashboard shows the next 5 actions tailored to your sales model, deal stage, and live signals — not a static checklist.

pillars.title: Weekly playbook drops
pillars.body: AI-generated playbooks adapt to what's actually happening in your pipeline. Stuck on inspection objections? Next week's drill is built around that.

pillars.title: Peer benchmarks
pillars.body: Your response time, conversion, and pipeline health stack-ranked against the platform-wide top quartile and your own moving average.

pillars.title: AI deep-dives (Top Producer Track)
pillars.body: Monthly: lead-source ROI heatmap, drop-off analysis, deal-coach reviews of your last 10 closings. Identifies patterns no human will spot.

methodology.heading: How the program runs every week
methodology.monday_body: Weekly playbook drops based on your live pipeline + recent metrics. 5 priority actions for the week.
methodology.daily_body: Today’s Action Plan tied to your sales model. Done / skipped tracked. Real-time peer benchmarks.
methodology.friday_body: Self-review summary: what closed, what stalled, what to drill next. AI surfaces patterns from the week’s data.

items.q: Is this a separate paid program?
items.a: No. Coaching is built into the plan price. Producer Track is included with Pro and above; Top Producer Track is included with Premium and Team. No upsell, no add-on fee.

items.q: What's the difference between Producer Track and Top Producer Track?
items.a: Producer Track gives you the daily plan, weekly playbooks, monthly review, and basic peer benchmarks — targeting 10 transactions and 3% conversion. Top Producer Track adds custom playbooks generated from YOUR live deals, monthly AI deep-dives, top-10% peer benchmarks, and priority access to new AI features — targeting 15 transactions and 5% conversion.
Yes — when you upgrade to a plan that includes a program, you're auto-enrolled the next time you sign in. You can opt out in settings; we won't re-enroll you automatically after that.

items.q: What about agents on the Starter plan?
items.a: Starter doesn't include coaching. Upgrade to Pro to start Producer Track, or Premium for Top Producer Track.

items.q: How do you measure the conversion-rate target?
items.a: Lead-to-close — the percentage of contacts created in CloseBoss (any source) that result in a closed transaction. Visible on your performance dashboard with a moving 12-month window.

cta.heading: Coaching is in every paid plan
cta.body: Producer Track auto-enrolls on Pro and above. Top Producer Track is bundled with Premium and Team. No coaching add-on fee, ever.
